# Get Studio

> Get Studio is a creative type foundry offering unique script, display, and handwritten fonts for designers and brands.

Get Studio provides both free and premium typefaces with flexible licensing options for commercial, broadcast, app, and web use. The foundry specializes in hand-crafted script fonts, variable fonts, and curated font bundles designed for modern branding and creative projects.

## Key Topics

- script fonts
- handwritten fonts
- variable fonts
- display fonts

## Core Platforms

- [Get Studio Homepage](https://www.getstud.io): Get Studio homepage showcasing script, display, and handwritten fonts
- [Font Shop](https://www.getstud.io/shop): Font shop featuring typeface products, bundles, and design assets
- [Free Fonts Library](https://www.getstud.io/freebies): Free fonts library including Keira Juniper, Metzel Script, Taldose

## Font Collections & Categories

- [All Fonts Catalog](https://www.getstud.io/font-category/fonts): Font catalog featuring typeface collection, bundles, and script fonts
- [Handwritten Fonts](https://www.getstud.io/font-category/handwritten): Handwritten font category with brush scripts and signature fonts

## Featured Typefaces

- [Pearlside – Variable Script Font](https://www.getstud.io/font/pearlside-variable-script-font): Pearlside variable script font with hand-crafted style in TTF/OTF/WOFF
- [Taldose - Font Duo](https://www.getstud.io/font/taldose-font-duo): Taldose script and Brookvale sans-serif font duo with multiple styles
- [New Roshelyn Script - Font Family](https://www.getstud.io/font/new-roshelyn-script-font-family): New Roshelyn retro script font family with swash tails and extrude version
- [Motion Handflow Font](https://www.getstud.io/font/motion-handflow-font): Motion Handflow casual handwritten font capturing natural pen strokes
- [Bongkah - Variable Font](https://www.getstud.io/font/bongkah-variable-font): Bongkah geometric sans-serif variable font for modern branding design
- [Redgato - Chunky Bold Display Font](https://www.getstud.io/font/redgato-chunky-bold-display-font): Redgato bold display font with sharp blocky letterforms for headlines
- [Lemonfields - Cute Handwritten Font](https://www.getstud.io/font/lemonfields-cute-handwritten-font): Lemonfields playful handwritten font with warm and spontaneous personality
- [Fat Grace - Playful Display Font](https://www.getstud.io/font/fat-grace-playful-display-font): Fat Grace bubbly display font inspired by groovy retro aesthetics
- [Sundance Cowboy - Font Duo](https://www.getstud.io/font/sundance-cowboy-font-duo): Sundance Cowboy western serif paired with Heartstrong script monoline
- [Country Farmland Script](https://www.getstud.io/font/country-farmland-script): Country Farmland free script font with rustic farmhouse branding style
